payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
outcome.target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.
outcome.reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing.

check.question: Does the edited image visibly fulfill the request to turn the image into a drawing made from chalk?
check.complete_when: The image is visibly rendered as a chalk drawing.
check.partial_when: A visible chalk-drawing effect is present, but the image is not fully transformed into a chalk drawing.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no chalk-drawing transformation has been made.
check.unknown_when: The available image evidence is insufficient to determine whether a chalk-drawing transformation was made.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image visibly renders the giraffes and surroundings with a soft, grainy, smudged chalk-drawing texture, rather than retaining the original photograph’s crisp detail."}

parsed.evidence: The edited image visibly renders the giraffes and surroundings with a soft, grainy, smudged chalk-drawing texture, rather than retaining the original photograph’s crisp detail.
